start: Watch app just installed, phone connected with MettleUp, no workout open

user_sees: "Heart rate" "1 of 2" with Allow and Not now

steps.action: Tap Allow, then on "Rest alerts" "2 of 2" ("Your watch buzzes when rest is over.") tap Allow
user_sees: "Turn on Alarms & reminders so your watch buzzes on time." with "Open settings"
must_not: The same screen back unchanged after Allow

user_sees: "Start a workout on your phone" and "Open MettleUp on your phone. Your rest timer shows up here."
must_not: "Phone not connected" while the phone is connected

start: A workout open on the phone, a rest running

steps.action: Open the app from the watch's app list, or tap the "Rest" countdown card
user_sees: The rest timer with the time left and the next set
"Workout saved" "Well done. See the details on your phone." for about 4 seconds
must_not: A jump straight to "Start a workout on your phone"

start: Phone's Bluetooth off, or a phone without MettleUp

user_sees: "Phone not connected" "Keep your phone near you with Bluetooth on." within a few seconds
Or "Get MettleUp on your phone" "Your watch needs the MettleUp app on your phone." with "Open on phone"
must_not: "Start a workout on your phone" when the phone cannot be reached

user_sees: "Look at your phone to install MettleUp." or "Your phone did not answer. Try again."

start: A rest running with the app open

user_sees: "Rest is over" with the time since, "−0:12", counting up

steps.action: Log the set on the phone
user_sees: The between-rests screen with the next set
must_not: "Rest is over" staying after the set was logged

steps.action: Close and open the app again
user_sees: The first-launch questions not asked again
